Surface batch-level parse observability so downstream apps can wire reporting (Sentry, structured logs) into the polling loop by subclassing — without forking the SDK or hand-rolling `getUpdates()`.

### Added

- `GetUpdatesResponse::$unknownMessageEntityTypes` — public deduped array of message entity type strings the SDK enum did not recognize during the batch. Lets callers stay ahead of additive Bot API changes (e.g. log a notice the first time a new type appears).
- `MessageEntity::flushUnknownTypeAccumulator()` — public drain for the private static side channel `tryCreate()` writes to. Called at every `GetUpdatesResponse::init()` boundary so unknown types from an earlier parse pass cannot leak into the next batch.
- `TelegramBotClient::getUpdatesResponseClass(): class-string<GetUpdatesResponse>` — protected factory hook. Override in a subclass to return a custom `GetUpdatesResponse` whose `init()` reacts to `$parseErrors` and `$unknownMessageEntityTypes`. `getUpdates()` now calls `($this->getUpdatesResponseClass())::make(...)` instead of hardcoding the SDK class.

### Changed

- `MessageEntity::tryCreate()` records unknown entity type strings into the new accumulator before returning `null`, so the silent skip remains tolerant but is no longer invisible to callers.
- `GetUpdatesResponse::init()` flushes the accumulator both before and after parsing — populating `$unknownMessageEntityTypes` from the post-parse drain.
